definitions.meaning: having the mind strengthened, stouthearted, courageous

quotations.old_english: Deareðlícende (the Huns) on Danúbie stærcedfyrhðe stæðe wícedon
Drógon hine (St. Andrew) ymb stánhleoðo stærcedferðe
quotations.english: cruelhearted ones dragged him about the stony slopes

source_text: stærced-, sterced-ferhþ; adj. I. having the mind strengthened, stouthearted, courageous :-- Deareðlícende (the Huns) on Danúbie stærcedfyrhðe stæðe wícedon, Elen. Kmbl. 75; El. 38. Stercedferhþe hæleþ, Judth. Thw. 22, 9; Jud. 55. II. of hard or cruel mind :-- Drógon hine (St. Andrew) ymb stánhleoðo stærcedferðe cruelhearted ones dragged him about the stony slopes, Andr. Kmbl. 2468; An. 1235.
